conviction_note: No decisive unpriced number: the peer and market series (ICA stores +4.6% vs market 4.2% May-Aug; Dagligvaruindex Q3 +4.0% vs ABG's assumed 4.4%) point to Willys still trailing the market against a consensus that is flat on EBIT, and the stock has re-rated +19% off its July low on four sell-side upgrades into a print where six of the last eight report days fell; set against that, inflation is returning (Matpriskollen) and comps are easier, so p_up is 44 on a 7% report-day scale, giving -0.84 against a findings sum of -1.5. The two differ because the sum stacks several small proxy leans that p_up only weights.

findings.finding: ICA Gruppen's second tertial (May-Aug) has ICA stores at +4.6% against market +4.2%, with ICA prices cut by more than the VAT. With ICA at roughly half the market outgrowing it, the rest (Willys, Coop, Lidl) grew below market through July-August. That supports Handelsbanken's continued-share-loss view over ABG's improvement call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Willys growth below market drove the -14.9% on 2026-07-15 (Willys +1.0%, group retail +2.1% vs market 3.7%) and the -9.1% on 2026-04-23. Above-market growth in Q3 2025 still saw the stock fall 7.1%.
findings.original_quote: ICA-butikerna ökade sin försäljning med 4,6 procent under tertialet, jämfört med marknadens tillväxt på 4,2 procent. (ICA stores grew sales 4.6% in the tertial, against market growth of 4.2%.) / I takt med att ICA:s matpriser sjunkit mer än momsen har vi sett en betydande volymtillväxt (As ICA's food prices fell more than the VAT cut we saw significant volume growth.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: SHB's 19 Oct preview already expects Willys below Dagligvaruindex. But ABG's buy case (Willys 3.7%, share gains), Danske's turnaround call and two September upgrades rest on the opposite reading, and the stock is +19% off its July low. A fully priced share-loss read would not look like a stock trading at 270 next to buy targets of 275-300.
findings.independence: Handelsbanken's preview reaches the same view by its own reasoning (https://www.placera.se/telegram/axfood-willys-kritisk-punkt-lar-tappa-marknad-aven-3-kv-shb-20261019); Matpriskollen's Mazur says some ICA Maxi stores are now cheaper than Willys (https://efn.se/kursfallet-i-axfood-analytiker-raknar-med-fortsatt-press)

findings.finding: Svensk Dagligvaruhandel's index puts Q3 2026 market growth at +4.0% (Aug only +3.3%), below the 4.4% ABG assumed when it forecast Willys at +3.7%. The top-line bar for a 'share gain' is lower, but so are absolute sales against a consensus of +2.5% net sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales against the market has been the deciding line on the last two report days (-9.1%, -14.9%).
findings.original_quote: Sett till årets tredje kvartal ökade den samlade dagligvaruförsäljningen med 4,0 procent jämfört med motsvarande period 2025. (Over the third quarter total grocery sales rose 4.0% on the same period of 2025.)
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 15 Oct and analysts can update for it. ABG's 4.4% assumption was published 6 Oct, before the September print. A slightly smaller market mostly moves the absolute sales line, not the relative one, so this stays small.

findings.finding: Danske Bank observed Axfood 'clearly stepping on the gas' on Willys price aggressiveness in July/August to re-widen the gap to ICA Maxi. That should help LFL but costs gross margin, against a consensus that cuts the margin only 10bp (4.8% vs 4.9%) and that ABG built on 'smaller' Willys price investments plus higher fuel costs at Dagab.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 miss (adj. EBIT 972m vs 1,006m expected, -3.4%) came with a -14.9% day; margin and growth missed together.
findings.original_quote: Enligt vår analys har Axfood tydligt tryckt på gasen när det gäller prisaggressivitet under juli/augusti för att återigen öka prisskillnaden mot huvudkonkurrenten Ica Maxi (In our analysis Axfood clearly stepped on the gas on price aggressiveness in July/August to widen the price gap to its main competitor Ica Maxi again.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is a sell-side observation, and the consensus margin (4.8%) only moves 10bp. If price investment were priced as a margin hit, the 1,091-1,101m bar would sit below last year's 1,099m by more than 0.7%. The sign is genuinely two-sided (volume vs margin), so it is small.
findings.independence: ABG names lower Willys price investments and higher fuel prices as the margin offsets (https://efn.se/abg-ser-uppsida-i-axfood-willys-vantas-ta-mark)

findings.finding: Matpriskollen: the share of grocery items with a raised ordinary price doubled to 19% in September from 10% in August, which it calls the first sign the autumn supplier negotiations are coming through. Management's outlook on food prices into 2027 is the question Handelsbanken says the stock turns on, and this gives it a factual basis to sound constructive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Axfood gives no numeric guide. In 2022 its Q3 'better on all points' came during inflation, and Danske notes inflation has historically correlated with Axfood share gains.
findings.original_quote: Att dubbelt så många varor fick högre pris i september är ett första tecken på att höstens förhandlingar börjar ge utslag (That twice as many items got a higher price in September is a first sign the autumn negotiations are starting to take effect.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the September upgrades (SHB, Nordea) and the 19% re-rating are built on returning inflation. What is not yet in the price is the company saying it. A market already holding it would leave little room for the stock to move on management's confirmation, so the finding is small and positive.
findings.independence: SHB (https://borsvarlden.com/artiklar/handelsbanken-hojer-axfood-till-kop-ser-vandning-for-livsmedelspriser) and Nordea (https://borsvarlden.com/artiklar/nordea-ser-attraktivt-ingangslage-i-axfood-hojer-till-kop) both expect food inflation back in late 2026-2027

findings.finding: Coop cut ordinary prices by an average 6.5% on its 600 best-selling items at Stora Coop (announced 5 Oct), explicitly to take on Willys and ICA Maxi. This is a Q4 competition question the call will be asked, per Handelsbanken.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 1.93% on 2026-10-05, the day of the announcement, and recovered 1.48% the next day.
findings.original_quote: Stora Coop sänker sina ordinarie priser med i snitt 6,5 procent på de 600 mest sålda varorna. ... – Vi ska ta fajten med Ica Maxi och Willys (Stora Coop cuts ordinary prices by an average 6.5% on the 600 best-selling items ... 'We will take the fight to Ica Maxi and Willys')
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock reacted on the day and recovered. What remains is whether management signals a price response that hits the Q4 margin, which only the call can say.
findings.independence: SHB names ICA's and Coop's campaigns as the follow-up question (https://www.placera.se/telegram/axfood-willys-kritisk-punkt-lar-tappa-marknad-aven-3-kv-shb-20261019)

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Six of the last eight report days fell and the last four fell 6.8-14.9%, including Q3 2025, when Axfood beat the market on growth ('Growth in all segments and increased market shares') and still fell 7.1%.
findings.original_quote: Kursutveckling vid senaste rapporterna ... Q2-2026 2026-07-15 -14,9; Q1-2026 2026-04-23 -9,1; Q4-2025 2026-01-29 -6,8; Q3-2025 2025-10-23 -7,1 (Share-price move on recent report days)
findings.why_not_priced: This is about the bar the price now holds, not a fact the market lacks. After a +19% re-rating on an inflation-turn thesis, a quarter that only meets a flat EBIT consensus with Willys still below market gives the new buyers nothing. A price that had not re-rated would sit near 230-240, where it traded in August.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative against a +2.1 priced_lean (driven by the short-squeeze term on a 3.91% aggregate that is not crowded) and a +4.9% 20-day run-up; the run-up is part of why the bar is high rather than a signal against the negative read.
language_note: The consensus split (Modular 1,101m / Infront 1,091m adj. EBIT), the report-day reaction table (-14.9, -9.1, -6.8, -7.1 ...) and SHB's Willys-vs-Dagligvaruindex framing came only from Swedish wire copy (Finwire/Börsvärlden, Nyhetsbyrån Direkt via Placera/EFN); the English search returned none of it.
ICA Gruppen's tertial store-vs-market numbers (4.6% vs 4.2%) and the 'prices cut more than the VAT' remark were in Swedish only.
The Dagligvaruindex Q3 +4.0% and the monthly split were Swedish (Svensk Dagligvaruhandel via Butikstrender/Börsvärlden).
Matpriskollen's September price-hike share (19% vs 10%) and Danske's July/August price-aggressiveness observation were Swedish-press only.
The issuer's own releases (Q2 report, Q3 invitation) are bilingual and added nothing in Swedish that the English versions lacked.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' / 'size on what is new': the period is not pre-released and this name's own report days run a median ~7% (Modular table), so abs_move_pct went from 6.0 to 7.0; p_up unchanged at 44, so expected_move_pct went from -0.72 to -0.84
Finding sizes unchanged: the proxy and peer findings were already small, and the positioning finding is not a restatement of a crowded short (3.91%, one holder building)

Not a lesson effect, recorded so the freeze reconciles: in the set check I merged the draft's two ABG margin-support items (youth employer-contribution cut +0.1, City Gross H2 profitability +0.1) into one +0.1 finding because they rest on one ABG note, so 10 findings summing to -1.4 became 9 summing to -1.5
